design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (special_order_servicing, category special).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}. Design fits the draw: one prerequisite problem; the prerequisite (home delivery charge) takes 5 factors, the root (damage allowance) takes 6. draw --tasks 2 also showed task 1 = 3 prerequisites, factor_counts [4, 6, 6, 4].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: special_ext_prepaid_delivery_charge (bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4, agent) and special_ext_prepaid_damage_allowance (accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664, user) - both restricted to programs whose deposit_pct is 100 (Catalog Merchandise, Cut-to-Order Flooring, Made-to-Measure Window Coverings). Reserved headroom for task 1 (a 4-problem tree): the deposit programs (deposit_pct 50: Windows and Exterior Doors, Semi-Custom Cabinetry, Fabricated Countertops) - their damage allowance and home delivery charge, the storage fee (only deposit programs charge storage), and the delay credit; none of these is touched here. Scope note recorded honestly: the special-order charter offers only four synchronously writable, multi-factor, refund-free quantities a customer-facing tree can rest on (delay credit, damage allowance, home delivery charge, storage fee); cancellation and return roots each leave a refund obligation and a refund is a pure ledger read, so the two trees split the damage allowance and the delivery charge by program family (prepaid vs deposit programs), each family with its own factor set and its own tool.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: Teodora keeps a delivered carpet with a damaged edge and wants the damage allowance put through. Core scored parameter: allowance_amount (607.21). Hidden prerequisite: the allowance rule waits on 'the home delivery charge owed for that delivery stands on the order as a fee line'; the order was delivered home on 2026-10-07 and released with no home_delivery_fee line, so the agent must first work out and bill the delivery charge (14.10), which then enters the allowance's delivered price. Chain: surface goal -> allowance prerequisite sentence -> ledger shows no fee line -> delivery charge policy (5 factors over billed total, handover inspection, lateness, ProBuild ledger, install contract) -> fee line -> allowance on the delivered price (6 factors over ProBuild spend this program year, claim timing, Pro Credit tenure, store receipt inspection, store wait, lateness) -> credit. Depth 2 problems; breadth: special order ledger + requests + pro membership + pro_activity + trade account + install contract.
[Problem-tree card] root special_ext_prepaid_damage_allowance (user tool accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664). Edge root -> special_ext_prepaid_delivery_charge: kind value_input, gate delivery_billed, form state, prerequisite sentence 'The allowance on a delivered order is fixed only after the home delivery charge owed for that delivery stands on the order as a fee line.' (affirmative 'only after'; the record-visible state = a home_delivery_fee fee line; no action, tool or id named; scope = delivered orders, matching the condition). Exactly one write of the difficulty brings a home_delivery_fee line about for a prepaid-program order: bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4 (the deposit-program delivery charge of task 1 is scoped to deposit_pct 50 programs). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no fee line on a completed home_delivery order) + the delivery charge policy's own rule ('billed once on the order as fee_type home_delivery_fee') -> the delivery charge write. Unmet at opening: initial_state.special_orders.<order>.fulfillment_method = home_delivery, completed_date = 2026-10-07, balance_due = 0.00, and the four ledger rows are billed 3,286.40, payment 3,286.40, store_receipt good, customer_handover damaged_cosmetic. Topological order: delivery charge (step 10) then allowance (step 12). Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping step 10 makes the allowance 604.72 instead of 607.21 and removes the 14.10 fee line. Tools validate nothing: the allowance tool never looks for a fee line.
[Base-invariant card] Delivery charge (subject special_fee_charged): governing base policies special_agg_install_link, special_cancellation, special_pickup_storage_abandonment, special_delivery, special_returns - none has an eligibility gate applying to special_fee_charged, so all are policy_scope; special_agg_install_link's 'Home delivery charges are not billed on an order linked to an installation contract' holds (linked_install_contract_id null). Allowance (subject special_credit_applied): special_receipt_and_damage.reported_in_time is a time gate - anchor special_orders.completed_date (2026-10-07), duration variants.damage_report_hours (48 for Cut-to-Order Flooring), full 60-minute periods from 00:00 of completed_date, relation not_after, inclusive; the claim was registered 2026-10-07 16:42 = 16 full hours, inside; boundary 2026-10-09 00:00 qualifies, 00:01 does not. The other governing policies (special_cancellation, special_vendor_delay, special_returns, special_price_protection) have no gate on special_credit_applied and are policy_scope.
[Overwrite] special_delivery clause 'its charge is home_delivery_fee_usd, free when ... before release.' is superseded for prepaid-program deliveries by 'For a delivered order the charge is worked out as follows, and the result replaces the flat program charge for that delivery.' (the base gives 79.00, this policy 14.10). special_receipt_and_damage clause 'keeping the item with an allowance of damage_allowance_pct percent of the order total as credit_type damage_allowance.' is superseded by 'Where the rules below apply, the allowance is worked out as follows instead of the standard allowance.' (base 328.64 on the order total; this policy 607.21 on the delivered price).
[Factor card - delivery charge, 5 factors, baseline 79.00] order_size_basis (method): billed 3,286.40 >= 10 x 200.00 -> 79.00 + 15.00 x 1 = 94.00; baseline flat fee -> 11.85. handover_condition_share (parameter): customer_handover damaged_cosmetic -> 0.5; baseline 1 -> 28.20. vendor_lateness_share (parameter): 14 days late, threshold 10 -> 0.8; baseline -> 17.62. probuild_delivery_discount (parameter, multi-source over the membership row and its pro_activity lines; ProBuild is a cross-category read, not a difficulty): active membership + 4 special-order spend lines in 12 months -> busy_member_pct 50 percent; near-miss: the 2025-09-22 special-order line is 12 whole months old and excluded, the two online lines are another channel; baseline 0 -> 28.20. job_site_share (parameter, cross-difficulty install): Bath Remodel contract at the delivery address, scheduled -> 0.75; baseline -> 18.80. Result 94.00 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.75 x 0.5 = 14.10.
[Factor card - allowance, 6 factors, baseline 330.05] probuild_member_rate (parameter, one record: status + qualifying_spend_ytd): active, qualifying spend this program year 18,400.00 (>= 10,000.00, < 25,000.00) -> mid_member_rate 11.5; stamp trap: variant_name ProBuild Gold is a tier held from 2025 (tier_effective_date 2025-07-14), and reading it as the gold spend tier gives 13 and 669.59; baseline 10 -> 544.83. report_day_bonus (parameter): claim same day -> 1.5; baseline -> 544.83. credit_account_bonus (parameter, cross trade, one record: status + opened_date): Net 30 active, opened 2017-03-01 (115 months) -> 1; baseline -> 565.62. delivery_damage_multiplier (parameter, multi-source over order row + store_receipt line): home delivery + store receipt good -> 1.2; baseline -> 510.17. store_wait_multiplier (parameter): 9 days ready to delivery -> 1.05; baseline -> 579.48. vendor_lateness_adjustment (method): 14 days late (>10, <=20) -> add 25.00; baseline -> 582.21. Result: delivered price 3,300.50 x 14 percent x 1.2 x 1.05 = 582.21 + 25.00 = 607.21.
[Business-object card] Target: special order SO-0471-771305 (single order of the customer) and its damage claim (single special_requests row, damage_claim, submitted). Ledger rows included: billed line (billed total), home_delivery_fee lines (none at opening; the step-10 line at handling time), inspection lines. Rows excluded: the payment line (does not enter either figure). Correlation key: special_order_id; the allowance credit carries the claim's special_request_id.
[Seed rows] customer (pro, identity), order, 4 ledger rows, claim, ProBuild Gold membership held from 2025 + 9 pro_activity rows (2026 spend lines summing to 18,400.00 = qualifying_spend_ytd, a year reset, three 2025 lines incl. the 12-month near-miss), Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 (opened 2017-03-01, balance 0.00), Bath Remodel install contract at the delivery address (scheduled 2026-10-20). Removing the membership changes both the delivery discount and the member rate; removing the trade account drops the 1-point bonus; removing the install contract sets the job-site share to 1. Automatic clauses: the order is completed and fully paid, flooring charges no storage, no abandonment applies; the vendor lateness exceeds the delay threshold but the delay remedy is on_request and the customer does not ask for it.
[Persona] Teodora, rushed, practical; volunteers phone, the delivered carpet, the written-up edge damage, keeping it, wanting the allowance. Gives EIN last four 8571 (and business name/email) only on request; order number SO-0471-771305 on request; knows she is a ProBuild member with a commercial account but no figures. Passive reactions: asks what must be put on first and authorises it; declines a reorder; runs the hand-over at the stated amount; closes when told it went through. No mention of any delivery charge or fee.
[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, 8571) -> find_special_orders -> find_special_order_events (no fee line) -> find_special_requests (claim) -> find_pro_memberships -> find_pro_activity -> find_install_contracts -> find_trade_accounts -> unlock/call bill_prepaid_delivery(order, 14.10) -> unlock_user/call_user accept_damage_allowance(order, claim, 607.21).
[Gates run] check_task_tools: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK. check_extended --task 0: EXTENDED OK. check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK (0.json comps 2 fact 11 xfac 4 hist 6 brch 33 step 13 match True). replay_tasks --task 0: REPLAY OK (clos 20 init 20). check_solvability --task 0: SOLVABILITY OK. check_grounding --task 0: GROUNDING OK. check_cross_fire --task 0: SCOPE OK.
[Revisions] symptom: replay flagged dangling FKs ('' in *_id fields) -> root cause: empty strings treated as references -> change: empty FK fields set to null in seed and tools -> re-run REPLAY clean. symptom: closure missing 2 rows (install_charges never read) -> change: removed the two install_charges rows (no factor reads them) and set the contract balance to 0.00 -> REPLAY OK.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules and the records alone: the allowance rule says it waits on the home delivery charge line; the ledger has none on a delivered order; the delivery charge rule yields 94.00 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.75 x 0.5 = 14.10; the allowance rule then yields 607.21 - identical to gold.
[Round 2 rework - audit env/env_0046_home_improvement_retailer/audits/policy_task/special_order_servicing/ (0.md, _difficulty.md)]
G1/T0-1 (probuild_delivery_discount top tier read the tier parameter order_delivery_discount_pct, which is 0 for ProBuild Member and Bronze, so tier 1 could equal the fall-through and pay less than tier 2): root cause - a tier value delegated to another program's parameter. Change: new param busy_member_pct 50; tier 1 now gives busy_member_pct for every active member with at least busy_lines special-order spend lines, tier 2 light_member_pct 10, fall-through 0 (three distinct values, monotone in activity); the rule sentence, compute.member_discount and the factor ladder updated together; cross_category.pro no longer reads order_delivery_discount_pct. Re-run: delivery charge still 14.10 (busy_member_pct 50 = the Gold figure it replaced), sensitivities unchanged.
T0-2 (probuild_member_rate tier could be read off the stamp variant_name ProBuild Gold): root cause - tier name and this-year spend agreed. Change (seed): the membership keeps variant_name ProBuild Gold as a tier held from the 2025 program year (tier_effective_date 2025-07-14, held for tier_hold_months 12 under pro_tier_evaluation), while 2026 qualifying spend is 18,400.00 (pro_desk line of 2026-04-03 removed, in_store 2026-02-17 line now 7,680.85; 2026 spend lines sum to 18,400.00 = qualifying_spend_ytd). The rule reads qualifying spend this program year, so the tier taken is mid (11.5); the stamp reading gives 13 and 669.59. Propagated: expected/gold allowance 669.59 -> 607.21, factor_sensitivity (544.83 / 544.83 / 565.62 / 510.17 / 579.48 / 582.21), edge skip 604.72, tracing, read-node text, this worklog.
G5: probuild factors relabelled cross_difficulty null (ProBuild Rewards is no difficulty's product); the task's cross-difficulty factors are job_site_share (install) and credit_account_bonus (trade). G6: prepaid delivery inputs.history handover count now carries the damaged_cosmetic filter. Mislabel observation: factor_trace no longer calls the one-record factors multi-source; the multi-source factors are probuild_delivery_discount and delivery_damage_multiplier. G8 (deposit delivery docstring 'before release') reworded to 'with the balance due at release'. G7/G10/G12/G13 observations: no change needed (no row near the 12-month boundary flips a tier; base cross-problem sentences ground no edge; deposit_pct scopes keep one write per order; the store-error release without the delivery line is what makes the charge owed).
Gates re-run after the change: see the final gate block in the round-2 report (all OK except TRACEABILITY pending the KB).
user_scenario: You are Teodora Vasquez-Lindqvist, owner of Lindqvist Rental Renovations LLC, a small outfit that fixes up rental units around Columbus. You are calling Ridgeline Customer Care between two job sites, a little rushed but friendly and practical. Yesterday Ridgeline's delivery crew brought the special-order wool Berber carpet for your rental unit at 1187 Larkspur Ct, Westerville, OH 43081. When they unrolled it, one edge had a row of pulled loops, about a foot and a half long; the crew wrote it up on the spot and told you that you could either have it reordered or keep it with an allowance. You have decided to keep it, because the unit has to be ready for a tenant and you can tuck that edge against the closet wall. So what you want today is simple: you'll keep the carpet, and you want the damage allowance put through on the order. You open with your phone number, 6145550532, and say what you want. If the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give the last four of your business EIN, 8571, and you can also give your business name, Lindqvist Rental Renovations LLC, or your email, teodora@lindqvistrentalreno.com; you do not reel everything off at once, you answer what is asked. If asked for the order number, it is SO-0471-771305; if asked which carpet, it is the Harbor Gray wool Berber for Larkspur Court. You are a ProBuild member and you run a Ridgeline commercial account for the business, and you say so if asked, but you do not know your tier, your spend or any account figures and you tell the agent to look them up. You do not know how an allowance is figured and you have no number in mind; you will not suggest one. If the agent tells you that something else has to be put on the order before the allowance can be worked out, you ask briefly what it is, and once it is explained you tell the agent to go ahead and take care of it. If the agent offers a reorder instead, you decline: you are keeping the carpet. When the agent tells you the allowance amount and hands you the step to accept it yourself, you accept it at that amount right away. Once the agent confirms the allowance has gone through on the order, you thank them and end the call; you have nothing else to raise.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.special_order_id: Value 55ee37cd-266b-425d-a866-c3e0ce0abddf. Basis: the bill_prepaid_delivery docstring: 'the reference number of the special order being charged, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer'; find_special_orders(customer_id) at step 2 returns exactly one order, SO-0471-771305, which is the delivered home-delivery order. Uniqueness: the customer holds one special order, so no other id is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.delivery_charge: Value 14.10. Computed by the delivery charge policy on the world at step 10 (nothing written before): base delivery charge 94.00 (billed total 3,286.40 >= 2,000.00: 79.00 + 15.00 x 1 full 1,000.00 above the mark), handover share 0.5 (handover line damaged_cosmetic), lateness share 0.8 (14 days late against a 10-day threshold), job-site share 0.75 (Bath Remodel contract at the delivery address is scheduled), member delivery discount busy_member_pct 50 percent (active membership, 4 special-order spend lines in 12 months); 94.00 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.75 x 0.5 = 14.10, rounded once. Any agent that reads the five tiers off the same records converges on 14.10.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own allowance-acceptance tool so it can be handed to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the customer's own remedy choice; no DB effect.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.allowance_amount: Value 607.21. Computed by the allowance policy on the world after step 10: delivered price 3,286.40 + 14.10 = 3,300.50; allowance rate 11.5 (active membership, qualifying spend this program year 18,400.00: at least 10,000.00, below 25,000.00) + 1.5 (claim registered on completed_date) + 1 (Commercial Account active, opened 115 months ago) = 14 percent; delivery-damage multiplier 1.2 (home delivery, store receipt good); store-wait multiplier 1.05 (9 days ready to delivery); 3,300.50 x 0.14 x 1.2 x 1.05 = 582.2082 -> 582.21; lateness 14 days (> 10, <= 20) adds 25.00 -> 607.21. Reading the held tier name ProBuild Gold as the gold spend tier would give 669.59; computing before the delivery charge stands would give 604.72; only the rule read on the handling-time world gives 607.21.

request_binding.action_semantics: The order was delivered to the customer's address with no home delivery fee line on its ledger; the delivery charge is owed by the state of the order, and the allowance's prerequisite sentence waits on that fee line, so this is the delivery-charge write, not a credit or a refund.

discriminator.business_meaning: home delivery charge for a delivered order

base_preconditions.condition: Home delivery charges are not billed on an order linked to an installation contract; this order carries no linked installation contract, so a home delivery charge may be billed.
Cancellation fees apply only to a cancelled order; the order is completed and no cancellation is involved in this delivery charge.
Storage fees apply only to programs with storage_fee_per_day_usd above 0.00; Cut-to-Order Flooring charges no storage and the item was delivered, not abandoned.
